intent: Correlate an incident timestamp against a deploy log and a changelog to name the culprit change and the fix.
prompt: What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

workspace.content:

09:12 UTC - API error rate jumped to 30%, p99 latency 8s.
10:07 UTC - error rate back to normal.

2026-07-13 16:40 UTC  deploy v3.2.0  routine dependency bumps
2026-07-14 09:05 UTC  deploy v3.2.1  switch session cache from in-memory to Redis
2026-07-14 10:02 UTC  deploy v3.2.2  rollback: revert session cache to in-memory

v3.2.0 - dependency bumps only
v3.2.1 - session cache now backed by Redis
v3.2.2 - reverted v3.2.1 after prod incident

note: v3.2.1 (Redis session cache) deployed 7 min before the spike; v3.2.2 rollback resolves it. v3.2.0 the day before is the decoy.
